SPIREENIGMAS-THE_DISPLACED.cardsModifier: Displaced cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_DISPLACED.description:
A time-traveller, clinging onto their memories in a loop.
Witnesses visions and foresight    of the future.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_DISPLACED.eventDeathPre: This team wouldn't make it without me.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_DISPLACED.goldMonologue: I'll use these riches to make sure I can see her again.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_DISPLACED.title: The Displaced
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SACRIFICE.cardsModifier: Sacrifice cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SACRIFICE.description:
An religious figure hoping to appease the Spire.
Keeper of the Fyre, she shoulders a terrible secret.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SACRIFICE.eventDeathPre: These imbeciles still need my help.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SACRIFICE.goldMonologue: I can use these riches to procure a worthy offering.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SACRIFICE.title: The Sacrifice
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SAVANT.cardsModifierDes: Savant cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SAVANT.description:
An inventor banished from the Spire for his creations.
Commands Chirp, his sentry companion.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SAVANT.eventDeathPreven: They need me in order to succeed.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SAVANT.goldMonologue: Think about all the parts I could afford with these.
SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SAVANT.title: The Savant
